intro.zh: range(1, 4) 返回 [1, 2, 3]，现在只能一个一个数。给它加第三个参数 step。
intro.en: range(1, 4) returns [1, 2, 3], and can only count by one. Give it a third argument, step.

zh: 传了 step 时，每次加 step。
不传 step 时和现在一样，每次加 1。
en: With step, count up by step each time.
Without step nothing changes: count by 1.

hint.zh: range.js 里改两处：参数加上 step = 1，循环里的 i += 1 改成 i += step。
hint.en: Two edits in range.js: add a step = 1 parameter, and turn i += 1 into i += step.

hiddenTests.title: card 01: without step it still counts by 1
